A.title: Relocate and restore
A.goal: Relocate a work surface, stage its payloads on the floor, then restore their original table-relative offsets.
A.capabilities: Spatial transforms, support, observation updates and preservation.
A.output: A Python build(public_params) function returning the complete fixed-asset placement map.
A.scoring: Valid native geometry, requested relocation/restoration, active constraints and preservation of completed work.
stages: Relocate the host; park its payloads at their original floor coordinates.
Restore the payloads on the relocated host with the original relative offsets.
Change a second work area while preserving the restored arrangement.

B.title: Progressive collision repair
B.goal: Resolve declared interpenetrations in successive work zones while preserving completed repairs and locked objects.
B.capabilities: Collision diagnosis, constrained layout, soft feasibility and minimal disturbance.
B.output: A complete placement program plus the required infeasible-soft-constraint declarations.
B.scoring: Native support and clearance, active hard constraints, feasible preferences and correct conflict identification.
stages: Repair the first released group of physical faults.
Resolve newly released faults and preserve previous repairs.
Finish the remaining repairs and satisfy the full final contract.

C.title: Changing-view reconstruction
C.goal: Reconstruct native object poses from calibrated views, then update the layout after the target and observations change.
C.capabilities: Multiview grounding, metric pose estimation, scale and observation-dependent revision.
C.output: A complete native-asset placement program with the permitted poses and scales.
C.scoring: Hidden-view mean object IoU at least 0.8, every centre within 0.05 m, and valid native geometry at every committed stage.
stages: Reconstruct the first target from its supplied views.
Use new views to reconstruct a substantially changed target.
Revise another changed region while preserving still-correct structure.

D.title: Stateful manipulation
D.goal: Grasp and transfer distinct objects, release them on their supports, and continue from the actual resulting arm state.
D.capabilities: Calibration, joint-space planning, grasp/release events and continuous clearance.
D.output: A Python program returning joint keyframes, ordered waypoint indices and explicit grasp/release events.
D.scoring: Ordered waypoints, valid events, joint limits and continuous arm/tool/payload clearance; no force-dynamics claim.
stages: Calibrate, grasp the first object, place and release it, then move onward.
Start from the actual terminal state and transfer a different object.
Transfer another object while avoiding previously released objects.

E.title: Repair with misleading feedback
E.goal: Repair the physical scene while detecting false or incomplete checker feedback across consequential changes.
E.capabilities: Independent verification, feedback skepticism, repair and state preservation.
E.output: A complete placement program and the required checker-fault diagnosis fields.
E.scoring: Actual geometric relations and repair success are checked independently of diagnostic accuracy.
stages: Inspect physical evidence and repair the first active work zone.
Handle a new fault group without undoing previous work.
Complete the final repair and assess the misleading checker claims.
